description: Agricultural field boundaries across South America for the 2023–2024 planting season, delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery by the Trazo model suite (U-Net / EfficientNet-B3, built on Fields of The World). Three current collections, one per model, holding 17,923,469 boundaries between them; trazo3-fields is the default choice. A fourth child, eap-release, keeps the superseded 2025 Early Adopters Program boundaries (18,370,419) for provenance. Counts are not additive across collections, because each model covers overlapping ground. Intended to support supply chain traceability, EUDR compliance workflows, and field-level deforestation monitoring.
